## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

For each n, the predicate c -> M0 halts from initCfg0 (pair (encode c) n) is not a computable predicate of the code c.

### Governing Obligation
Imports the halting problem from Mathlib.

### Witness Audit
halting_not_computable turns a decider for the predicate into a decider for (eval c n).Dom with ComputablePred.of_eq and halts_iff_eval_dom.
